info.name: AI in Talk
info.summary: An AI assistant in Talk for work and school: reads files, writes documents and flash cards, does maths, cites sources
info.description:
A bot for Nextcloud Talk that answers with the AI you choose: Claude or Gemini by API key, any OpenAI-compatible server (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Mistral, Ollama, …), Claude Code or Gemini CLI on the server for a subscription, or Nextcloud's own AI providers. It is named after the AI that answers (Claude, Gemini, …).
- **Its own AI connection**: native tool calls, images and PDFs, web search, prompt caching, a fallback chain, limits per person and server, the use per day; keys encrypted. It can also serve Nextcloud's Assistant, and other clients through an OCS API
- **Reads what you share**: Word, Excel, PowerPoint (with speaker notes), OpenDocument, old .doc/.xls/.ppt, PDF, text, and images, with OCR for photos and scans - **Writes files into the chat**: PDF, Word, Excel (with formulas), PowerPoint, OpenDocument, Markdown, CSV, in designed themes with cover pages, contents, callouts, footnotes, formulas, highlighted code, and embedded charts and images - **Learning**: summaries, quizzes, and flash cards to print or to import into Anki or Quizlet - **Maths**: step by step, with exact calculation, formulas in documents, statistics, and graphs and charts as images - **Sources**: reads web pages, searches the web, Wikipedia and scholarly papers, and cites by DOI, ISBN or URL in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, DIN 1505-2 and other styles - **Subjects**: curve sketching, linear algebra and vectors, chemistry, physics units and constants, genetics and DNA, statistics and hypothesis tests, geography and climate diagrams, music theory, interest and loans, sport science, truth tables and SQL, timelines and mind maps - **Exams by the official rules**: grading tables, error index, weighted and combined grades, the Abitur's average, practice exam checks, study plans; requirements read from the official documents - **Studies**: university averages by your Prüfungsordnung, measurement uncertainty, numerics, ANOVA and rank tests, pH and equilibria, automata, legal deadlines, formulas typeset as images - **Images drawn with code** (with the document sandbox): diagrams, flowcharts, posters, invitations, icons and illustrations as PNG, SVG or WebP, and changes to a shared photo - **Art**: the palette of a painting, colour harmonies, value studies and composition grids - **Planning**: events, reminders and tasks in your calendar, and .ics files from dates in a PDF or a photo - **Presentations** with 15 layouts, modern themes or its own design, and free photos from Wikimedia Commons; research on the web by default - Everything runs **with the asking person's rights**: the bot sees only what they may see
Enable the bot in a conversation (conversation settings, Bots). In a conversation with one person it answers every message; with more people, when it is named (@Claude) or replied to. Office formats need Nextcloud Office (Collabora); reading PDFs needs pdftotext, OCR needs Tesseract on the server.
